notes.title: Sector clear: Hryaken destroy
notes.notes:
Comrade, before you is Cleanup: Destruction of Hryaken - a game where the task is to destroy the army of Hryaken and clear the territory to the last pig! An endless series of randomized fields awaits you, where each move brings you closer to victory or can lead to defeat. It's not just a puzzle game - it's a battle for survival.

Your weapons are strategic thinking and unique bonuses hidden in seemingly simple objects. Forget air raids and heavy bombs - you can use pots of geraniums as your “attack drones” and the legendary tulip pots as a reference to the powerful mortars of the Great War.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2426030/Zachistka_Unichtozhenie_Xryakena/

notes.title: Archibald 2
notes.notes:
King Glass returned after defeat, gathering an army of bodyguards!

But the brave warrior Archibald did not sit with folded arms - now he has a shield (right mouse button), and the arrows have acquired new properties!

Continuation of the arcade game Archibald.

Shoot from the bow at the enemies, avoid obstacles, use the shield to protect against the arrows of the enemies.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1053300/Archibald_2
